rulings.Rulings: Matter on calendar for Wednesday, August 26, 2026, Line 9, PLAINTIFF MARTE BASSI's Motion To Lift Stay, Or, In The Alternative, To Modify Stay As To Plaintiffs Complaint. Plaintiff Marte J. Bassi's Motion To Lift Stay, Or, In The Alternative, To Modify Stay As To Plaintiffs Complaint is GRANTED. This action was stayed pending the outcome of an arbitration ordered by the court on 4/7/2025. The arbitrator has issued a final award, and, in fact, the court has confirmed the award. (See SA.F. Super. Court Case No. CGC-26-519664.) Satisfaction of the arbitrator's award (or related judgment) is irrelevant to the stay issue. The outcome of the arbitration is now known and, therefore, the stay should be lifted. The court orders the stay lifted. rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motion To Deem Defendants Victor Nguyen And Brian Wong Served, Or In The Alternative, For Alternative Service Via Secretary Of State
rulings.Rulings: Matter on calendar for Wednesday, August 26, 2026, Line 12, PLAINTIFF STEPHEN MASSEY's Motion To Deem Defendants Victor Nguyen And Brian Wong Served, Or In The Alternative, For Alternative Service Via Secretary Of State. Plaintiff Stephen Massey's unopposed Motion To Deem Defendants Victor Nguyen And Brian Wong Served, Or In The Alternative, For Alternative Service Via Secretary Of State is OFF CALENDAR. Plaintiff failed to demonstrate he timely filed and served his moving papers. (See Code of Civil Procedure section 1005(b) [motion must be filed and served 16 court days before hearing]; Code of Civil Procedure section 1013(a) [service by mail where place of address and place of mailing are within State of adds 5 calendar days to the period of notice]; see Code of Civil Procedure section 1010.6(a)(3)(B) [service by email adds two court days to "any period of notice"]; Code of Civil Procedure section 1013(e) [service by fax only be agreement and adds two court days to "any period of notice"].) Plaintiff's moving papers include an RJN that was not filed until 8/10/2026, which is not 16 court days plus two days before 8/26/2026, the hearing date noticed. Moreover, Plaintiff has not identified any authority authorizing email service on a party who has yet to appear in the matter. Plaintiff is advised that motions, such as this one, must be noticed for and heard in the master calendar department, Department 206. (San Francisco Local Rules, rule 3.1(c).) LINE 14. 2-DEFENDANT AMOUSSOU BOCO's Notice Of Joinder To Defendant Uber Technologies, Inc., Raiser, Lcc And Rasier-Ca, Llc?S Motion To Dismiss The Case Based On Forum Non- Conveniens; Request For Judicial Notice. Defendant Uber Technologies, Inc., Rasier, LLC, and Rasier-CA LLC's motion to dismiss based on forum non-conveniens is DENIED. The tentative ruling in its entirety has been emailed to the parties. For the 9:00 a.m. calendar, all attorneys and parties may appear in Department 302 remotely or in person. Remote hearings will be conducted by videoconference using Zoom. (Dept. 302 Zoom ID 160 409 7690; Passcode 516287.) To appear remotely at the hearing, go to the court's website at sfsuperiorcourt.org under "Online Services," navigate to "Tentative Rulings," and click on the appropriate link, or dial the corresponding phone number. Any party who contests a tentative ruling must send an email to contestdept302tr@sftc.org with a copy to all other parties by 4pm stating, without argument, the portion(s) of the tentative ruling that the party contests. The subject line of the email shall include the line number, case name and case number. The text of the email shall include the name and contact information, including email address, of the attorney or party who will appear at the hearing. The court no longer provides a court reporter in the Law & Motion Department. Parties may retain their own reporter, who may appear in the courtroom or remotely. A retained reporter must be a California certified court reporter (CSR), for only a CSR's transcript may be used in California courts. If a CSR is being retained, include in your email all of the following: their name, CSR and telephone numbers, and their individual work email address. =(302/JMQ)
